WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count
  FROM account a
  LEFT JOIN `order` o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_orders
  FROM order_counts
),
above_avg_accounts AS (
  SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count
  FROM order_counts oc, overall_avg oa
  WHERE oc.order_count > oa.avg_orders
),
above_avg_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_above_avg
  FROM above_avg_accounts
)
SELECT 
  aa.account_id,
  aa.order_count,
  aa.order_count - oa.avg_orders as above_overall_avg,
  aa.order_count - bam.avg_above_avg as above_above_avg_mean
FROM above_avg_accounts aa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
CROSS JOIN above_avg_mean bam
ORDER BY above_above_avg_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
